subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The new employee said that he was ________ of doing the job well.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

The correct ans. is- **option 3**

confident means-**feeling or showing that you are sure about your own abilities, opinions, etc**

Ex-***I feel confident of passing/that i can pass the exam.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

let's explore other words

sufficient-**as much as is necessary; enough**

diffident-**not having confidence in your own strengths or abilities**

efficient-**able to work well without making mistakes or wasting time and energy**
